plugins.photosPermission: Control+ needs to see your photos so you can show the assistant a picture of something you are worried about. Photos are only sent when you choose one and press Send.
plugins.cameraPermission: Control+ needs the camera so you can photograph a message or a warning on your screen and ask the assistant about it. Photos are only sent when you press Send.

plugins.microphonePermission: Control+ needs the microphone so you can ask your question out loud instead of typing it. Your recording stays on this phone and is never sent anywhere.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Control+ turns what you say into writing on this phone, so you can check it and correct it before anything is sent. Your voice is never sent anywhere.
